newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen allocates $1.6 mln to restore Aden airport.
newsitem.headline: Yemen allocates $1.6 mln to restore Aden airport.

text.p: Yemen has allocated $1.6 million to repair the airport in the southern port city of Aden which was damaged during a 1994 civil war, a newspaper said on Wednesday.

The independent al-Ayam newspaper quoted an official at the airport as saying the National Trade Company had begun preparing designs to repair the runway, terminal and tower. It said actual work would commence in February 1998.

An official said earlier this year that the government was planning to use $20 million in aid, including a $14 million World Bank loan and $6 million worth of equipment from France, to repair the airport. ($1=125 rials)
